description: This file contains SQL commands and PL/SQL blocks for creating XML database schemas, registering schemas, renaming tables, uploading files, and managing directory permissions related to the 'order_entry' schema in an Oracle database environment.

methods.name: registerSchema
methods.description: Registers an XML schema with the database using DBMS_XMLSCHEMA.

methods.name: renameCollectionTable
methods.description: Renames nested collection tables within the database.

methods.name: uploadFiles
methods.description: Uploads files into the specified directory in the database repository.
